_comment_composition: LAB-based liquid scintillator (linear alkylbenzene solvent), the real JUNO target. Bulk optical transport is dominated by the LAB solvent (PPO/bis-MSB fluors set EMISSION, which point-source calibration does not use, so no scintillation block here). Unlike wbls.json/water.json this does NOT inherit the SK water parametrization — LAB is chemically distinct (n=1.48 vs 1.33; Rayleigh ~28 m vs ~250 m at 430 nm), giving the high-contrast LS<->water interface (critical angle ~64 deg, significant TIR).
_comment_refractive_index: LAB n_D = 1.4833 at 589 nm (sodium D); dispersion raises it to ~1.49 at the 430 nm scintillation/Cherenkov peak. Single scalar 1.48 used here (critical angle vs water 1.33 is 64.0 deg). See 'Refractive index in the JUNO liquid scintillator' (Eur. Phys. J. C, 2024).

scattering.source: Rayleigh scattering of LAB: arXiv:1504.01001 (Eur.Phys.J.C 75 (2015) 545), L_Rayleigh(430 nm) = 28.2 +/- 1.0 m via Einstein-Smoluchowski-Cabannes. NOT the SK water parametrization.

symmetric.description: Pure Rayleigh law alpha_sym = P4/lambda^4 (P5=0): Rayleigh scattering is fundamentally lambda^-4. P4 normalised so 1/alpha_sym(430 nm) = 28.2 m -> P4 = 430^4 / 28.2 = 1.212e9.

asymmetric.description: Forward Mie alpha_asym = P6*(1 + P7/lambda^4*(lambda-P8)^2). Purified LAB scattering is Rayleigh-dominated; Mie (residual particulates) is removed by purification -> P6=0 (negligible Mie). The LAB Rayleigh anisotropy (depolarization ratio 0.31, arXiv:1504.01001) is already folded into the measured scattering length above.

absorption.source: EFFECTIVE absorption (pure-absorption model, no re-emission — see docs/TWO_BOUNDARY_PLAN.md). Derived from the JUNO attenuation-length requirement L_att(430 nm) >= 20 m (arXiv:1507.05613) MINUS the measured Rayleigh scattering L_scat = 28.2 m: 1/L_abs = 1/20 - 1/28.2 => L_abs(430 nm) = 68.8 m (alpha_abs = 0.01454 /m). This is a fit-TARGET prior, not a measured LAB absorption spectrum.
absorption.description: Flat effective absorption alpha_abs = P0*P2 (P1=0 -> no UV lambda^-4 term; P3=0 -> lambda-independent). LAB has no measured absorption spectrum in this functional form, so a flat L_abs is the honest prior; the pope_fry table repeats the same constant so alpha_abs is flat across the whole band.
